messages.content: 基于核实的官方基线，在独立 worktree 开发自实现 C++20 数据库。使用磁盘 COW B+ 树、语句 EOF/根指针保存点和原子 catalog 发布，避免全库常驻内存；以 fsync(data)、fsync(catalog.next)、rename、fsync(directory) 后才确认提交。正式驱动缺失，因此通信适配器明确标记 LOCAL，并继续验证不依赖协议的核心。
先建立精确扫描三轮基线，再比较物理向量 postings。初始索引只小幅降 T，却增加 IO/M；检查发现成功路径的错误字符串分配。改用 string_view 后延迟构造，再将向量边界检查合并为整段检查。保留每阶段代码提交、源码摘要和实际三轮数据；索引只由显式 SQL 创建，不宣称综合官方成绩更优或近似 ANN 加速。

experiments.command: Initial regression using host directory bind mounts; focused same-container / named-volume controls
experiments.environment: Docker Desktop on macOS arm64; LOCAL adapter
experiments.output:
2026-11-09, production Linux amd64 image on Docker Desktop/macOS arm64.
Command: python3 tests/regression.py --binary tests/docker_db.py
Initial harness used two separate bind mounts of one macOS temporary directory.
Failure: regression.py directory-lock assertion failed.
Focused reproduction:
  second container returncode 0
  stdout b'{"ready":true,"protocol":"minivectordb-local-v1"}\n'
  stderr b''
Control using one Linux named volume:
  second process in same container: returncode 74, empty stdout,
    stderr b'minivectordb: data directory is in use\n'
  second container on same volume: returncode 74, empty stdout,
    stderr b'minivectordb: data directory is in use\n'
Resolution: container_suite.py gives each test a Linux named volume, shared on
restart and competing opens. No assertion or production lock was removed.
Limitation: cross-container locking of macOS bind mounts is not supported by
this observed Docker Desktop filesystem configuration; use Linux volumes.
